data.name: Mashael
data.long_meaning: The name Mashael is derived from the Arabic language, meaning 'a gentle breeze'. It is a name with a spiritual and calming connotation, evoking images of peace and tranquility. In Islamic history, the wind is often seen as a symbol of divine guidance and renewal. For Muslims, the name Mashael serves as a reminder of the gentle and guiding hand of Allah.
